maintenance_led.reason: Earns fees from insurers and agents for customer leads and referrals on new policy shopping, not servicing installed assets.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by private auto, home and other P&C insurance carriers and agents; consumers use it free.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows organically through its online insurance marketplace and carrier relationships; only occasional small acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Carriers buy leads and customer-acquisition traffic; they can shift marketing spend to other lead sources or channels easily.
